title: Grove: Smart Bin
intro: Build a bin that opens its lid when your hand comes near, shows a light while it's open, and checks the lid really closed. Each part plugs in with one Grove cable.

steps.title: How far is your hand?
steps.text:
The Ultrasonic Ranger in port **D7** measures distance with a click and its echo. The `readCm()` **function** does the measuring and gives back centimetres, so `loop()` can just ask for it.

**Your task:** run it, open the Serial Monitor, and move something closer (the distance slider in the simulator).
hints: The distance slider is next to the drawing.

checks.label: The number gets smaller as my hand comes closer

steps.success: Your bin can sense a hand.

steps.title: Open the lid
steps.text:
When a hand is close, open the lid (servo to 90°), turn on the light, wait 3 seconds, then close it again.

**Your task:** choose how close counts as "a hand" (fill in the blank).
hints: A hand over a bin is usually closer than 15 cm.

checks.label: The lid opens when my hand comes near

steps.success: A hands-free bin! (The cm > 0 part ignores readings where no echo came back.)

steps.title: Check it closed
steps.text:
**Goal:** after closing the lid, wait (up to 2 seconds) for the **micro switch** to be pressed by the lid. Print "open" when it opens, "closed" when the switch is pressed, or "lid stuck!" if it never is. Only turn the light off once it's closed.

The micro switch in port **D2** reads HIGH when its lever is pushed.
hints: Wait with `while (digitalRead(SWITCH_PIN) == LOW && millis() - start < 2000) { delay(10); }`
Afterwards, check `digitalRead(SWITCH_PIN) == HIGH` to choose "closed" or "lid stuck!".

checks.label: It says closed when the switch is pressed
You used millis() for the time limit
checks.name: millis

checks.label: It notices if the lid doesn't close

steps.success: Your bin checks its own work, like real machines do.

outro: You built a Smart Bin from four Grove modules, with a **function** for the ranger, a **servo** lid and a **micro switch** that checks the lid closed.
stretch: Add a Grove Buzzer that plays a short tune when the lid opens.
Count how many times the bin opens today and print it.
Use a second Ultrasonic Ranger inside the lid to tell how full the bin is.
